description: SignalTender Self-Improving Anti-Regression Rule Ledger. Automatically populated by omniscient_auditor.py and auto_error_healer.py on every bug fix and enforced on every subsequent run.

rules.bug_signature: Raw [ALERT] Discord webhook notifications sent upon bug detection before self-healing runs
rules.root_cause: send_discord_alert() functions posted directly to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL with **[ALERT]** text prior to auto-remediation.
rules.fix_applied: Rewrote all send_discord_alert() implementations to log silently via report_error() and emit Discord notifications strictly via send_discord_resolution() ([RESOLVED]) after fixing.
rules.prevention_rule: Never emit raw [ALERT] notifications to Discord when a bug is detected; capture errors silently via report_error(), auto-heal the issue, codify a permanent prevention rule, and dispatch only a [RESOLVED] notification.

rules.bug_signature: Stale portal, state, or API counts appearing in UI badges, deep-dive panels, or outbound email queues
rules.root_cause: Adding a new scraper or API without updating all surface strings and regenerating static pSEO / outbound queues.
rules.fix_applied: Added automatic count-drift healer across index.html, apis.html, pseo_generator.py, and outbound conversion surfaces.
rules.prevention_rule: Automatically synchronize n_portals, n_states, n_apis, and n_tier2_apis across all website, pSEO, MCP, and outbound surfaces before every verification pass.

rules.bug_signature: Cold email or social post referencing a /contracts/rfp/<slug>.html URL that does not exist on disk
rules.root_cause: Contract directory or slug updates occurring without re-running pseo_generator.py and outreach_generator.py.
rules.fix_applied: Added 1:1 URL-to-disk verification for campaign_leads.csv, outbox_ready_queue.json, and sitemap.xml with automatic regeneration.
rules.prevention_rule: Every Top Contract Dossier URL in campaign_leads.csv, outbox_ready_queue.json, x_ready_posts.json, and sitemap.xml must resolve to an existing static HTML file in contracts/rfp/.

rules.bug_signature: Rolling timedelta() dates, process-salted abs(hash()), or PostgREST RLS 42501 .upsert() failures
rules.root_cause: Non-deterministic fallback dates/IDs causing synthetic SF-30 duplicates or .upsert() triggering RLS 42501.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced AST & regex checks banning timedelta(), abs(hash(), .upsert(), and legacy Claude 3/4 models across all scrapers.
rules.prevention_rule: All scrapers must export async def run_scraper(push_to_db: bool = True), use deterministic anchored dates and SHA-256 IDs, use SELECT + .insert(), and use claude-sonnet-5-5.

rules.bug_signature: Tool count, description prefix, or manifest version mismatch between remote HTTP MCP and NPM STDIO MCP
rules.root_cause: Updating one MCP server or manifest version without syncing the counterpart.
rules.fix_applied: Added automatic version and tool-schema parity sync across mcp.py, mcp-server/index.js, server.json, and mcp-server/package.json.
rules.prevention_rule: Keep tool count, 5/5 Glama TDQS annotations, and manifest versions 100% synchronized across mcp.py, mcp-server/index.js, server.json, and mcp-server/package.json.

rules.bug_signature: Autonomous audit and self-healing jobs running during daytime hours while the operator is actively using the computer
rules.root_cause: Background watcher and audit invocations lacked a nighttime + Windows user-idle (GetLastInputInfo) gate.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced is_nighttime_and_user_away() (11:00 PM – 6:00 AM local time AND >= 30 minutes of keyboard/mouse idle time) across omniscient_auditor.py, silent_autopilot_watcher.py, and windows_autopilot_guard.py.
rules.prevention_rule: Autonomous full-system audits and self-healing runs must only execute at night (11:00 PM – 6:00 AM local time) when the user is away (>= 30m idle via GetLastInputInfo), unless explicitly invoked with --force-now.

rules.fix_applied: Auto-healed & verified by auto_error_healer.py (28/28 scrapers & pipeline contracts healthy; cleared 4 local + 3 remote alert(s))
rules.prevention_rule: Enforce 100% portal/state count and abbreviation roll-call parity across index.html, apis.html, pseo_generator.py, and all outbound/conversion surfaces before any commit.

rules.bug_signature: Already-warmed sending mailboxes (stat_warmup_score >= 85) detached from campaign email_list or blocked by an artificial 14-day wait
rules.root_cause: Defaulting min_days=14 in is_instantly_account_warmed() detached active mailboxes on already-warmed domains, cutting daily send capacity and stalling Step 2/Step 3 thread replies.
rules.fix_applied: Set min_days=0 default in is_instantly_account_warmed() so all active mailboxes with stat_warmup_score >= 85 remain attached to the campaign with continuous warmup enabled.
rules.prevention_rule: Never detach or impose a 14-day wait on active mailboxes with stat_warmup_score >= 85, and never call accounts/warmup/disable on active campaign mailboxes.
